about_the_game:
In this chapter, you take on the role of Liam, a test subject who has been forcibly exposed to a series of macabre and experimental procedures designed to push both his body and mind beyond their limits. As he struggles to preserve his sanity, Liam must navigate the dimly lit corridors of the Foundation’s hidden facilities—an environment where every shadow whispers a story and every room conceals a fragment of a forgotten truth.

While searching for an escape, he will uncover multiple intertwined narratives, learning that not all anomalies are locked behind containment doors... some reside deep within the human mind. Experience one of the Foundation’s most catastrophic scenarios firsthand: the Containment Breach, where control collapses and survival becomes the only protocol.

This installment of The Foundation Survive offers a single-player, story-driven horror experience focused on psychological tension, environmental storytelling, and immersive atmosphere.

Built in Unity, the game utilizes dynamic lighting, 3D spatial audio, and AI-driven environmental behaviors to enhance immersion and realism. The player interacts with the environment through first-person exploration, document analysis, and observation-based tasks that reveal the nature of the anomalies.

Each sequence is designed to blend narrative progression with experimental gameplay mechanics, creating a balance between fear, investigation, and discovery.

No internet connection is required — all content is offline and single-player, ensuring a fully contained experience.
